verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਨ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਾਨ ਬਦੋ ਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਸਿਆਨ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਮਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਅਉਸਰ ਅਭੀਚ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: maanan na keejai maan badho na tero siaan mero kahio maan jaan aausar abheech ko ||

en.bdb: Do not consider wisdom in this pride. Listen to me and regard this human birth as the most auspicious and invaluable time to meet with the Lord. Make this chance a success by taking the initiation of Naam Amrit from the True Guru and practicing it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਕੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਆਈ ਬਾਰੀ ਲੇਹੁ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਸੰਗ ਛਾਡਿ ਹਠ ਨੀਚ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: pirayaa kee anek piaaree chira(n)kaal aaiee baaree leh na suhaag sa(n)g chhaadd haTh neech ko ||

en.bdb: Dear Lord has numerous beloved wives whose hearts are pierced with His ambrosial Naam. After wandering in many species, you have now got the turn to meet with the Lord through this human birth. Why don't you give up your arrogant obduracy and unite with your Lord husband?

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਜਨੀ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਗਾਤ ਖੇਲਹੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਖ ਬੀਚ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: rajanee bihaat jaat joban si(n)gaar gaat khelahu na prem ras moh sukh beech ko ||

en.bdb: This night-like human life is passing away. The youth, body and all its adornments will be left behind. Then why don't you enjoy and relish the loving elixir of your dear husband? And why are you wasting your night-like life in the false pleasures of maya?

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕੈ ਨ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਾਥ ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਥ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਡੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਚ ਕੋ ॥੬੬੦॥
verses.translit_en: ab kai na bheTai naath bahurio na aavai haath birahaa bihaavai bal baddo bhaiee meech ko ||660||

en.bdb: And if you fail to achieve union with your master Lord in this human birth, you will not get another opportunity. You will have to spend the remainder life in the separation of the Lord. The separation is far more painful than death.  (660)
